definitions.full: H2609. Chanes חָנֵס proper name, of a location Isa 30:4 in Lower Egypt, on island in Nile, south of Memphis (|| צֹּעַן ) = Egyptian Hnnstn [* –néns® ], Assyrian –ininši; Herodot ii. 137 Ἄνυσις , afterward Heracleopolis magna , now Ahnâs ; see Steind BAS i. 602 .

occurrences.englishText: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.
